incidents.name: DRLVaultV3
incidents.notes: DRLVault.swapToWETH traded through the USDC/WETH pool with no effective slippage guard, so the attacker sandwiched the vault after manipulating the pool price.

sources.ref: Recheck of the deployment basis (DELEGATECALL audit): the victim is an EIP-1167 minimal-proxy clone whose 45-byte runtime hardcodes the master 0x8aa6b0e10bd6dbaf5159967f92f2e740afe2b4c3 (created at block 23731141), so the DELEGATECALL target cannot be repointed; the master's runtime is byte-identical at the clone's creation block 23767200 and the incident block 23769387 and contains no DELEGATECALL, so the 7.3-hour age is measured from the deployment of code that never changed.
